description: Activate when: user says 'monopoly vs competition,' 'competition is for losers,' 'zero to one,' 'do we have a moat,' 'is this market too crowded,' 'how do we escape competition,' or 'start small and monopolize'; a startup or product is entering a category with many similar players and the user is deciding whether/how to compete; someone is sizing a market and the definition of 'the market' is doing suspicious work (looking dominant in a tiny niche, or looking small inside a huge one); planning niche-first expansion sequencing. Do NOT activate when: the question is industry-level attractiveness for an outsider or investor (use porters-five-forces); the question is legal/antitrust monopoly regulation; the business is deliberately a commodity player competing on operational excellence and the user just wants execution help. More: deciqai.com/c/monopoly-vs-competition

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
